correctness.rationale: A full proof reconstructs the normalized Fourier coefficients and their recurrence; proves absolute summability and the sign of every coefficient at all noninteger orders; uses zero total mass plus sharp row norms for the finite gamma formulas; applies Wiener inversion for the exact endpoint spectral radius; identifies all alternating-sign mismatches for the strict gap; differentiates the absolutely summable coefficient tail at integer powers and sums explicit beta terms to get the universal 2/m jump; and proves the order-zero strong-limit dichotomy by density and endpoint witnesses. The exact tail identity and high-precision Fourier-integral checks in verify.py passed 739 assertions. Finite computations are not invoked as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Endpoint operator norms give the exact worst-case amplification of an important discretization of fractional differential order. A countable sequence of sharp integer-order cusps, each of precisely quantified strength 2/m, identifies sensitivity at every local-to-nonlocal transition. The strict normaloidity gap and the ℓ1/ℓ∞ strong-order-zero failures versus interior ℓp convergence distinguish several natural stability concepts for the same canonical family. These structural, all-order results are motivated independently of the computational formula and not a selected unmotivated parameter slice.
